title: Three Summers and One Short Walk
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：friendship　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 friendship 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my grandmother ① kept a friendship that no neighbour in the street would have named, and she said the keeping was the whole of the summer. The ② friendship, meaning the bond itself and not the visit, ran three summers and stayed unnamed in the book; a friendship, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ friendship in that street had the same short walk beside it, and the ④ friendship at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A friendship, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandmother said the naming is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the friendship was the whole of the matter, meaning the kindness and not the bond. The ⑥ friendship, meaning the kindness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; friendship, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a bond and a kindness. He said the kindness is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ friendship had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short walk. The ⑧ friendship of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in August, was one street and three summers of naming; friendship, she said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ friendship I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the street. A ⑩ friendship, my mother said in 1977, is the only one that improves by being named; every friendship, she said, is a kindness that has agreed to look like a bond. She said the kindness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 友谊；友情（指街上每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 友谊（指那一份本身，与一次拜访相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a friendship 维系一份友谊
D. n. 友谊（指留给孩子们的那一份）
E. n. 友谊（抽象总称，指一条街上的交情之事）
F. n. 友谊（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一份）
G. n. 友善；友好（的态度）（指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 友善（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: kept a friendship that no neighbour in the street would have named
The friendship, meaning the bond itself and not the visit
the friendship at the far end
the friendship was the whole of the matter

answers.why: keep a friendship 意为“维系一份友谊”，1966 年祖母维系了一份街上没有一位邻居肯说出名字的友谊。
friendship 意为“友谊”，指那一份本身而不是一次拜访，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
friendship 意为“友谊”，指街上每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一段短短的散步。
friendship 意为“友谊”，指留给孩子们的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
friendship 意为“友善、友好的态度”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份友善就是那件事的全部。
friendship 意为“友善”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那份友谊，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
friendship 意为“友谊”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一份，到 1973 年这一份成了计划里的一行。
friendship 意为“友谊”，祖母八月写道，整件事的交情之事是一条街道和三个夏天的说出名字。
friendship 意为“友谊”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一份，1975 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一份。
friendship 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，一份友谊是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
